limitations: Homogeneous cyclic root-gap model only; the background eventual variance coefficient is cited rather than newly derived. General weighted-clock models and other finite-size variances are not covered. Potential implicit overlap with general weighted cyclic consecutive-pattern operator theory remains.
scientific_integrity: The two boundary formulas are proved analytically using a cyclic priority representation, a local excursion kernel, and positivity of Brownian-bridge covariance. Finite exact-rational enumeration independently checks illustrative cases; independent audit is not performed.
title: Sharp finite-size cutoffs for cyclic valley-gap moments
